note: Formula 1's title could be decided in Mexico City today.

front.title: Apple's new MacBook Pro and macOS 27 are built for touch
front.tldr: Apple's new MacBook Pro has a PROLED XDR touch display, the first touchscreen Mac, and macOS 27 adds touch gestures to match. A genuine shift for a laptop line that resisted touch for 15 years.

front.title: Hamilton becomes F1's oldest pole-sitter in 44 years with first Ferrari pole
front.tldr: Lewis Hamilton edged out George Russell to take pole for the Mexico City Grand Prix, his first for Ferrari and the team's first of the season. At 41, he is F1's oldest pole-sitter since 1982.

front.title: 'Green Room' director recalls how Patrick Stewart saved the film from being scrapped
front.tldr: Director Jeremy Saulnier says 'Green Room' was close to being shelved until Patrick Stewart unexpectedly asked to join the 2015 thriller. Ahead of a Friday screening, he credited Stewart's interest with saving the project outright.

stories.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
stories.tldr: Security researchers at Parameter Labs found a way to hijack ChatGPT accounts through OpenAI's artifacts feature, the tool once called Canvas. A reminder that AI products carry the same security risks as any other software.

stories.title: Apple's CEO says the company doesn't want to 'ship AI for AI's sake'
stories.tldr: Apple's chief executive defended the company's cautious approach to AI, saying it won't ship features just to keep pace with rivals. A rare public defence of Apple's slower, more deliberate product strategy.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
stories.tldr: OpenAI's latest funding round is reportedly falling short of its original target, a signal that investor appetite for AI mega-rounds may be cooling after a year of record raises.

stories.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia
stories.tldr: Nvidia is reportedly considering guaranteeing financing for Nscale's new West Virginia data centre, as nervous lenders look to the chipmaker to underwrite the AI building boom it sells into.

stories.title: From restaurant guides to payments, here's how TikTok is building a super app
stories.tldr: TikTok is quietly expanding into restaurant recommendations and payments, following the WeChat playbook of becoming the single app people use for most of their digital life.

stories.title: I took two iPhones on vacation. The Duo won me over.
stories.tldr: TechCrunch's review of Apple's dual-screen iPhone Duo found real frustrations but enough charm to beat going back to a Pro Max, a useful data point on whether the device is more than a gimmick.

stories.title: Xbox manager says AI is already being used in game development
stories.tldr: An Xbox manager said AI use is already widespread in game development, then deleted the comments from X a day later, hinting at how sensitive the topic remains inside studios.

stories.title: Apple shows off HomeView's software in a new tour
stories.tldr: Developer Steve Troughton-Smith shared a detailed tour of the software running Apple's upcoming HomeView smart home hub, giving the clearest look yet at the interface ahead of its launch.

stories.title: iPhone 18 Pro sales surge in China, offsetting decline in U.S. and Japan
stories.tldr: A 29% sales jump in China is offsetting weaker iPhone 18 Pro demand in the US and Japan, according to Counterpoint Research, underlining how central the Chinese market has become to Apple.

stories.title: Apple Maps begins blurring NASA, Space Force, and Air Force bases
stories.tldr: Apple has started blurring satellite imagery of NASA, Space Force and Air Force sites in Maps, a quiet change spotted by enthusiasts who regularly zoom in on launch pads for fun.

stories.title: 'Pluribus' Season 2 reportedly starts production today
stories.tldr: Filming on the second season of Apple TV's acclaimed sci-fi drama 'Pluribus' is reported to begin today in Albuquerque, a quick turnaround that suggests Apple wants the show back soon.

stories.title: 'Fuxi: Four Tales of Feasting' review: whimsical Chinese film explores myth through food
stories.tldr: In Qiu Jiongjiong's latest, elaborate sets and costumes build a strange banquet of storytelling in which food carries the plot, reviewed at the Tokyo International Film Festival.

stories.title: Austin Film Festival announces script and film competition award winners
stories.tldr: 'Paper Plane', 'Helicopter' and 'Old Bogus Massacre' topped this year's Austin Film Festival script and film competition, chosen from more than 12,500 submissions and 78 finalist scripts.

stories.title: Alex Gibney-produced 'Mohabat' wins top prize at Ji.hlava documentary festival
stories.tldr: James Longley's 'Mohabat', produced with Oscar-winner Alex Gibney, won the main documentary prize at the Ji.hlava festival, praised by jurors as meticulously researched and exquisitely crafted.

stories.title: Artisans break down the tricks and treats of designing a Trojan Horse at SCAD Savannah Film Festival
stories.tldr: Production designer Ruth de Jong, editor Sarah Broshar and costume designer Amy Roth told IndieWire about the hidden craft choices built into their work, at SCAD's Behind Their Lens panel.

stories.title: Payton Pritchard scores 30 to lead Celtics past Bulls in comfortable NBA Cup win
stories.tldr: Payton Pritchard scored 30 points on 6-for-8 shooting from inside the arc, getting to the free-throw line nine times, as the Celtics beat the Bulls comfortably in their NBA Cup opener.

stories.title: The Celtics' defense is winning in a new way
stories.tldr: Boston's defense forced 16 turnovers against the Bulls, 10 of them steals, an early-season pattern CelticsBlog says is coming from an unfamiliar source for this team.

stories.title: The Mayes keep showing up at Market Baskets. Fans can't get enough.
stories.tldr: Drake Maye's family keeps turning up at Market Basket stores around New England, and fans wearing his No. 10 jersey can't get enough of the impromptu meet-and-greets.

stories.title: Patriots' A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson ruled out vs. Dolphins
stories.tldr: Wide receiver A.J. Brown and running back TreVeyon Henderson are ruled out for today's game at Miami, with running back Lan Larison signed to the 53-man roster to cover for Henderson.

stories.title: Antonelli feeling 'tense' amid effort to seal F1 title
stories.tldr: Kimi Antonelli admits he is more tense than usual ahead of Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix, where he could seal his first Formula 1 world championship.

stories.title: F1 2026 Mexican Grand Prix starting grid with Verstappen penalty
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen and Liam Lawson both picked up grid penalties for their practice collision, reshuffling the Mexico City Grand Prix starting order ahead of today's race.

stories.title: Willson Contreras on what he thinks Red Sox need to do this offseason to improve
stories.tldr: Willson Contreras set out what he thinks the Red Sox need to fix this offseason, putting the decision back in chief baseball officer Craig Breslow's hands.

finally.title: Em-Estudio lines Mexico City bar with walls of books
finally.tldr: Mexico City's vintage bookshops inspired this basement bar, lined floor to ceiling with walls of books, designed by local studio Em-Estudio in the Roma neighbourhood.
